description: H₂O H–O–H angle magnitude via trace-weighted VSEPR (points-on-a-sphere, Coulomb kernel, NO fit parameter). Domain weights are q-exact Markov traces (w_lone/w_bond = h z + 1). Self-validates at equal weights (θ=109.47°). Trace weights give θ≈107.2° (narrows ≈2.3°): correct sign and order of magnitude vs observed 104.5° (narrows 4.97°); residual reported, not fitted. Supplies the geometric stiffness a for prop:h2o-bond-angle-shift's b/(2a).

data.finding: Trace-weighted VSEPR (Coulomb, no fit) predicts θ_HOH ≈ 107.19° — narrowing ≈2.3° vs observed 5.0°. Right sign + order of magnitude; the 10% q-exact trace asymmetry under-predicts the full shift by ~2×. The residual is honest (not fitted): closing it would require a tuned kernel/asymmetry, forbidden by the no-magnitude-fit rule. Self-validates at equal weights (109.47°).
